issue.title: A working-directory spawn ENOENT is reported as the Claude executable being missing
issue.body:
Found by WP-F5 (#102 launch diagnosis) and confirmed by its independent GPT-6.1 Sol review on 2026-10-19. Outside every I01 to I07 bolt; filed for triage.

## Defect

A spawn `ENOENT` caused by the working directory is reported as the executable being missing: Claude preflight says "The installed Claude executable could not be started" (`HARNESS_NOT_INSTALLED` class) when the real cause is a working directory the process cannot start in.

## Steps

1. Point `TEMP`/`TMP` at a directory whose path is 234 characters or longer (the Claude CLI starts from working directories up to 258 characters and fails from 259; the probe directory adds the rest).
2. Run `node apps/api/dist/main.js --preflight` or `GET /harness/preflight`.

Expected: a message that names the working directory as the cause, or at least does not claim the executable is missing.

Actual: "The installed Claude executable could not be started", while `claude --version` works from a short directory.

## Cause

`packages/infrastructure/src/claude/harness.ts:67-70` maps every spawn `ENOENT` to the not-installed class. The same applies to a turn whose run workspace exceeds 258 characters.

## Fix shape

Distinguish a cwd-caused `ENOENT` (check the working directory exists and is startable before spawning, or inspect the error path) from a missing executable, and word the problem accordingly. Coordinate with WP-F1 (#179), which rewrites the readiness classification in the same file.

## Related

#102 (record `docs/qa/2026-10-19-wp-f5-launch-diagnosis.md`), #179.


## Intent 4 delivery admission — November 21

Admitted after [intent 3 engineering delivery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/279#issuecomment-7059784448) on signed main `02351e2fb932b3be44e7cc3fb3943a61d568226c`, under the owner's ordered batch and delegated blocker-decision authority. [D171 and its alternatives](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/427#issuecomment-7059806202) distinguish coordinator selection from human plan approval. Historical parking text above remains history.

Actual Claude Code Opus implements the bounded spawn diagnostic correction. Distinguish evidence about invalid/ambiguous working directories from a confirmed unavailable executable; preserve cancellation, deadline and proven non-submission. Use harmless native fixtures and no raw private path disclosure.

Implementation and opposite-family review use the named routing models at xhigh. **Independent QA agent (planned):** `i4_364_behavior_qa`, a separate context and checkout; actual provider/session/build/evidence will be recorded when dispatched. GPT owns architecture; Claude Code contributes implementation, design critique, QA and adversarial review. Preserve touched-system positive/negative QA, unchanged coverage, current-head/current-target CI, fresh independent Astra MAX final audit and the three-general-scan cap. No implementation, QA or acceptance is implied by admission. Owner-only closure obligations and held460/Mac501 remain separate.
